01 / THE HEART OF RAU GARHI

A little of yesterday.
A whole lot of heart.

There is something about a wada. The familiar red brick. The shelter of a tiled roof. The way a conversation stretches long after a meal.

Rau Garhi brings that feeling to the table. A heritage space where families gather, friends catch up, and everyday moments find a special place.

A FEW LITTLE THINGS

Before you visit.

How do I reserve a table?

Fill in the reservation form to open a message to our team on WhatsApp. Send the message and we’ll reply with availability and confirmation.

Can I plan a celebration or a group visit?

Of course, tell our team your date, group size, and occasion on WhatsApp. We’ll help you plan and confirm what’s available.

Where can I see the current menu?

Use “Ask for our menu” to contact us directly. Our team can share the latest menu, specials, and help with dietary questions.

What are your opening hours?

Please call or message us for current opening hours and table availability before you travel.
